description: Wonderwhales demo execution (ADR 0007): closed-bar PinePort\Wonderwhales signals, one guarded broker position with mandatory SL/TP, risk-percent lot sizing, daily/drawdown/streak locks and a kill-switch file. Execution enabled by default on demo (ADR 0006); set InpEnableExecution=false for a dry-run comparison. Demo account or Strategy Tester only; real accounts are rejected at OnInit.

assumptions.account: demo or Strategy Tester only; real/contest accounts are rejected at OnInit (ExecContextAllowed -> INIT_FAILED)
assumptions.signal: PinePort\Wonderwhales buffers BUY_SIGNAL/SELL_SIGNAL read on the last closed bar; PSAR and ATR% come from the same bar; no signal is used before InpWarmupBars
assumptions.position_model: at most one broker position filtered by symbol and InpMagicNumber; no grid, DCA or averaging
assumptions.stops: InpStopMode 0 = PSAR line, 1 = ATR% x InpAtrPctMultiplier, 2 = fixed points; every stop is tick-normalized, respects InpMinStopPoints and the broker stop level
assumptions.take_profit: mandatory at InpTakeProfitR times the initial risk; SL and TP are re-asserted if the broker drops them
assumptions.exits: initial SL, optional InpExitOnFlip on the opposite signal and optional InpMaxHoldingBars; no break-even or trailing in v1
assumptions.sizing: InpRiskPercent of equity at the initial stop via OrderCalcProfit (ExecCalcProfit), floored to the volume step and capped by InpMaxLots; an order that needs more than the cap is skipped, never rounded up. On a 5,000 USD demo account 1% is about 50 USD, which fits the 0.01 minimum lot while the PSAR stop is under about 50 USD; wider-stop signals are skipped by design
assumptions.locks: InpMaxDailyLossPct, InpMaxDrawdownPct and InpMaxConsecutiveLosses gate new entries; a breach halts the EA and flattens the position when execution is enabled
assumptions.kill_switch: create InpKillSwitchFile in MQL5/Files to close the position and stop entries until restart
assumptions.state: risk ledger and position context persisted to MQL5/Files; delete or reset the state file before a clean replay
assumptions.results: demo execution is an operational check, not a performance or live-readiness claim; no profit is promised
